name: system_stats
description: Report how the computer is doing: part 'all' gives one overview (processor, memory, graphics card, disks, battery); 'cpu' only the processor, 'gpu' only the graphics card (VRAM, load, temperature, power), 'ram' only memory, 'disk' only disk space. Processor and graphics card answers include temperatures where the machine exposes them.

part.description: which part to report; all (default) for the general question, otherwise exactly the part the user named

drive.description: only for disk: a drive letter such as C; empty for all drives

examples: how much vram is in use
how much ram am I using
how much disk space do I have
how full is my C drive
not_for: which program is using the CPU or memory
